Here’s a high‑end Keras project that ties together vision and language with advanced co‑attention—suitable for your 50 years of ML/AI/DS mastery:

Project Title

ai‑ml‑ds‑QyF9ZrWkopL – Fine‑Grained Visual‑Textual Co‑Attention Classifier with Keras
Filename: fine_grained_visual_textual_coattention.py

Short Description:
Build a dual‑stream Keras model to classify bird species by fusing image data and natural language descriptions using fine‑grained visual‑textual co‑attention. Dataset: CUB‑200‑2011 via tensorflow_datasets (paperswithcode.com).

# fine_grained_visual_textual_coattention.py

import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow import keras
from tensorflow.keras import layers
import tensorflow_datasets as tfds

# Hyperparameters
IMG_SIZE: tuple[int,int] = (224,224)
EMBED_DIM: int = 256
LSTM_UNITS: int = 128
ATTENTION_UNITS: int = 64
CLASS_COUNT: int = 200

# Load dataset
(ds_train, ds_test), ds_info = tfds.load(
    "caltech_birds", split=["train", "test"], with_info=True,
    as_supervised=True)

def preprocess(image: tf.Tensor, text: tf.Tensor, label: tf.Tensor):
    image: tf.Tensor = tf.image.resize(image, IMG_SIZE) / 255.0
    text: tf.Tensor = tf.strings.substr(text, 0, 100)
    return {"image": image, "text": text}, label

ds_train = ds_train.map(preprocess).batch(16).prefetch(2)
ds_test = ds_test.map(preprocess).batch(16).prefetch(2)

# Image tower
image_input = layers.Input(shape=(*IMG_SIZE,3), name="image")
x_img = keras.applications.ResNet50(include_top=False, pooling="avg")(image_input)
x_img = layers.Dense(EMBED_DIM, activation="relu")(x_img)

# Text tower
text_input = layers.Input(shape=(), dtype=tf.string, name="text")
vec = layers.TextVectorization(max_tokens=20000)(text_input)
x_txt = layers.Embedding(input_dim=20000, output_dim=EMBED_DIM)(vec)
x_txt = layers.Bidirectional(layers.LSTM(LSTM_UNITS, return_sequences=True))(x_txt)
x_txt = layers.TimeDistributed(layers.Dense(EMBED_DIM, activation="tanh"))(x_txt)

# Co-attention
img_proj = layers.Dense(ATTENTION_UNITS)(x_img)  # [B, U]
txt_proj = layers.Dense(ATTENTION_UNITS)(x_txt)  # [B, T, U]
score = tf.matmul(txt_proj, img_proj[...,None])  # [B,T,1]
score = layers.Softmax(axis=1)(score)
context = tf.reduce_sum(score * x_txt, axis=1)    # [B, E]

# Fusion & Output
fusion = layers.Concatenate()([x_img, context])
fusion = layers.Dense(EMBED_DIM, activation="relu")(fusion)
output = layers.Dense(CLASS_COUNT, activation="softmax")(fusion)

model = keras.Model([image_input, text_input], output)
model.compile(optimizer="adam", loss="sparse_categorical_crossentropy", metrics=["accuracy"])
model.summary()

# Train
model.fit(ds_train, validation_data=ds_test, epochs=10)

# Save
model.save("fine_grained_coattn_bird.h5")

Example Use Cases

  1. Input: A bird image + caption “This bird has a long red beak and white belly.”
    Output: Predicted species index (e.g., 56)
  2. Input: “Small blue bird with yellow wings” + photo → species prediction.

Key Learnings & Research Areas

  • Core Components: ResNet50, TextVectorization, Bi‑LSTM, fine‑grained co‑attention
  • Keywords/Hashtags: #CoAttention, #Multimodal, #FineGrainedClassification, #Keras, #ResNet50, #BiLSTM
  • Research Directions: Transformer‑based multimodal fusion, zero‑shot learning via text embedding, explainability via attention visualization

Project Metadata

  • Problem domain: Fine‑grained multimodal classification (images + text)
  • Frameworks: TensorFlow 2.x, Keras, TensorFlow Datasets
  • Full lifecycle: Data ingestion → preprocessing → two‑stream modeling → attention fusion → training → evaluation → deployment → monitoring → model iteration
  • Sister projects: Visual Question Answering, Cross‑modal Retrieval, Zero‑Shot Recognition
  • Integrations: Deploy via TensorFlow Serving; embed in mobile or web apps; integrate with explainability tools (e.g. LIME, SHAP); extend to active learning setups
  • Timestamp: 2025‑07‑01
  • Estimated duration: 4–6 weeks corporate cycle (data prep, model dev, testing, deployment)
  • Final product: A trained multimodal classifier + demo UI that shows species prediction and attention highlight maps over image/text

Pro Challenge (Bonus):

  • Implement dual co‑attention: add visual attention syncing with text context
  • Pre‑train with contrastive loss between modalities (CLIP‑style)
  • Add attention map visualization API, explaining which image regions & words influenced prediction

Next Steps:

  1. Replace ResNet50 with ViT or Conv‑Mixer
  2. Shift to Transformer encoder for text and image
  3. Expand to zero‑shot classification via embedding alignments
  4. Deploy scalable model with A/B testing
